verdict.rationale: Anrok documents certificate upload via UI/API and searchable customer records (anrok-docs-1, anrok-docs-4, anrok-docs-22) plus a marketing claim that certificates are 'collected, verified, and stored' (anrok-docs-21), showing collection and storage support. However there is no evidence of expiry tracking or of certificates being automatically applied to exempt transactions at tax-calculation time. Missing for 10: expiry/renewal tracking, explicit linkage of stored certificates to automatic exemption application during calculateTax/createEphemeral calls, and any customer-facing collection workflow (e.g., self-serve upload portal).
